iteratorCli.limits: Same built package and private CLI run function; disables callback delivery. One extra small ESM entry module compared with direct CLI startup.

metadata.method: Fresh sequential child processes, rotated/reversed order. Optional previous CLI receives identical input paths and must produce byte-identical complete JSON. Spawn to close and first stdout byte. Child kernel VmHWM sampled every 2 ms; a final peak can be missed.
metadata.limits: Fixture-derived synthetic inputs, unique identities, no replay/fork/snapshots/native cost. Daily/model counters match; Huihua additionally serializes confidence, provenance, diagnostics and per-session results. No real-user or production speed claim.

profiling.limits: One actual CLI CPU profile on the content fixture-derived input; instrumentation changes runtime. Not included in the repeated complete-output timings and not a causal measurement of ccusage.
